caption: Attribute Dictionary
description: The attributes of the Infrastructure as Code extension.
name: dictionary

iac.caption: IaC Source
iac.description: The infrastructure-as-code source that manages the resource.

tool.caption: IaC Tool
tool.description: The tool that applies the configuration: terraform or opentofu.

address.caption: IaC Address
address.description: The address of the resource in the configuration, as the tool names it, such as module.db.aws_db_instance.main or aws_s3_bucket.logs["a"].

module_address.caption: IaC Module Address
module_address.description: The address of the module call the resource is in, such as module.db, or module.a.module.b for a nested one. Absent for a resource in the root module.

repo_url.caption: Repository URL
repo_url.description: The URL of the source repository that holds the configuration, such as https://github.com/example/infrastructure.

commit_sha.caption: Commit SHA
commit_sha.description: The hexadecimal ID (40 or 64 characters) of the commit of the repository the configuration was taken from.

workspace.caption: IaC Workspace
workspace.description: The name of the workspace whose state records the resource.

state_key.caption: IaC State Key
state_key.description: The key of the state that records the resource in its backend, such as the path of the state file in a bucket.
